Preserve all9directed source grading edges and fully translate all7required provider lessons. Optional navigation wrappers do not recursively force the corpus; preserve every Japanese comparison/readings even when its link target remains absent.

ある is intransitive existence/possession, with が rather than an invented objectを. Preserve irregular ordinary negativeない, notあらない. いる living presence is distinct from要る needing; do not mapている mechanically to Russian aspect.
する is irregular; noun+する applies to established action nouns, not any noun. Preserve choiceにする and sensed音がする. Abilityできる requires nounができる or verb dictionary+ことができる; never bare dictionary verb+できる.

なる is intransitive, with noun/na-adjectiveに and i-adjectiveく. Preserve参考になる as a whole contextual expression; distinguish鳴る. Separate dictionary archaic/suffix/slangなる is only qualified safeguard evidence, not primary N5 teaching.
Preserve casual/register and recipient/hierarchy cautions forやる/あげる/渡す; neutral handover does not itself establish a gift or ownership transfer.

Preserve 作る/造る spelling tendencies without a universal spelling rule; all Japanese ships/sake examples and their readings remain. 工業 is manufacturing industry, not all industries; preserve both long vowelsこうぎょう.

Preserve 借りる receiving temporary use versus 貸す lending out, including paid rental contexts. Do not infer Russian ambiguity merely from Englishrent or mistranslate normativeодалживать without evidence.
Preserve 切る godan切って versus 着る ichidan着て; distinguish transitive無くす loss/elimination from亡くすbereavement; preserveplacement destinationに versus action-placeで and the fullておく construction boundary.
Preserve 貼る adhesive versus 張る tension coverage. An API object sharing forms does not license writing every張る sense with貼る; no stretching/tightening or price safeguard is proposed on that basis.

Preserve 違う as a verb,comparisonと and contextual correction, not an adjective withcopula. 要る godan要らない differs from livingいるいない; need/desire contrast remains despite a separately bounded wanted-sense safeguard proposal.
生産 primaryせいさん is production. The separately capturedせいざんlivebirth object is not taught as the N4 production reading or declared impossible. Separate付くづくsuffix is not the primaryつく lesson.

Official JMdict independently verifies rare-kanji-form annotations for居る/為るする/為るなる/遣る; the API omission was not proof. Only targeted spelling and reading elements were read, not all official sense bodies; securewww hostname succeeded afterftp TLS mismatch, with no bypass.

All67direct safeguards remain proposals:9exact source edges+15direct taught/source senses+43explicitlylimited context/dictionary protections. No acceptance, inferred cliques, stronger modern necessity/frequency, native/media or activation claims.
